findings.requirement: US-7 (AC7): fetch_mattel_article → None when HTTP 404 specifically
findings.detail: AC7 cites 'HTTP 404' as an explicit trigger. The test test_http_error_returns_none_and_notifies is marked KEEP. In the old parser, 404 was detected via contentArticle-is-null logic; in the new parser, it is detected via raise_for_status() → HTTPError → ES6. The kept test likely mocks at the requests level (transparent to detection path), but the tech-spec does not call out that the detection mechanism changed and why the KEEP annotation is still valid. A future auditor seeing KEEP may not realise the 404 path now goes through raise_for_status. Low implementation risk; documentation gap only.

findings.requirement: US-18 (Constraint: no __NEXT_DATA__ backward-compat; rollback → separate mini-feature)
findings.detail: The backward-rollback handling is now documented (ES3 + paragraph in Architecture). The scope boundary 'if site reverts — separate mini-feature, not part of this rewrite' is stated in user-spec Constraint section but is not echoed as an explicit constraint in the tech-spec. The tech-spec Acceptance Criteria deletes _NEXT_DATA_RE but does not state 'no dual-format support in this module.' This is a minor omission — the behavior is correct, just the constraint boundary is not restated.

findings.requirement: Testing Strategy — test count inconsistency between section header and Acceptance Criteria
findings.detail: Testing Strategy section header states '29 tests after the rewrite (15 keep + 11 update + 3 new)'. The Acceptance Criteria section states '32 in test_mattel_news_source.py (15 keep + 11 update + 6 new)'. Counting individual items listed in the Testing Strategy body: TestIsHotwheels(5) + TestBuildEntry(5) + TestExtractEntries(4) + TestFetchMattelNews(5+4+1=10) + TestFetchMattelArticle(1+5+3+2=11) + TestSsrfGuard(1) + Anti-drift(2) = 38 entries. The round-2 additions (3 new tests for AC3/AC6/AC7) were added to the body list but the header total was not updated from 29 to 32, and the 32 in Acceptance Criteria already accounts for them. The inconsistency between '29' (header) and '32' (AC) will confuse the implementer about the expected final count. The authoritative number appears to be 32 (AC section), but the Testing Strategy header should match.
